description: This is a FastAPI router module for managing saved views within dashboards. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, and deleting saved views, interacting with SQLAlchemy models and a real-time notification manager.

methods.name: None _ensure_dashboard(db: AsyncSession, *, dashboard_id: uuid.UUID, org_id: uuid.UUID, ws_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Checks if a dashboard with specified ID, organization, and workspace exists; raises 404 if not.

methods.name: List[SavedViewResponse] list_saved_views( dashboard_id: uuid.UUID, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(get_auth_context), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of saved views for a specific dashboard.

methods.name: SavedViewResponse create_saved_view( dashboard_id: uuid.UUID, payload: SavedViewCreate, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_permission("saved_views:write")), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new saved view for a dashboard and publishes a real-time notification.

methods.name: None delete_saved_view( dashboard_id: uuid.UUID, saved_view_id: uuid.UUID, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_permission("saved_views:write")), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Deletes a specific saved view and publishes a deletion notification.

ctags.name: _ensure_dashboard

ctags.signature: (db: AsyncSession, *, dashboard_id: uuid.UUID, org_id: uuid.UUID, ws_id: uuid.UUID)

ctags.name: create_saved_view
ctags.signature: ( dashboard_id: uuid.UUID, payload: SavedViewCreate, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_permission("saved_views:write")), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )

ctags.name: delete_saved_view
ctags.signature: ( dashboard_id: uuid.UUID, saved_view_id: uuid.UUID, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_permission("saved_views:write")), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )

ctags.signature: ( dashboard_id: uuid.UUID, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(get_auth_context), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
